purpose: Encodes a string payload as an inline SVG QR code with an explicit accessible label.
useWhen: Presenting a scannable URL, token, or Wi-Fi credential that users can scan from another device.
You need a theme-aware QR graphic that stays crisp at any scale.

avoidWhen.reason: You only need to expose a copyable short text value without camera scanning affordance.
The payload is sensitive and should never be displayed as machine-readable visual data.
